Add a schema_drift_detection note connecting the 650-credit-threshold statement at 05:49 to the schema's already-documented SESSION18_fcbf33c1 drift precedent (both instances say 650 vs the schema's 670) — this is a second data point worth flagging for Kenny. Optionally note the 01:36 'send me packet, don't want anyone out before decision' moment as a soft variant of the send_proposal_before_meeting rebuttal trigger that Stage 3 did not analyze. The battery/Powerwall cross-sell framing at 02:12 should be softened — the schema does not yet define a battery_storage cross-sell trigger (it's listed as TBD/future catalog), so this should be flagged as a schema-gap observation rather than presented as an established missed cross-sell parallel to the roofing signal.
